name: contenta-converter
description: Contenta Converter for Windows: batch image conversion, resizing, effects, metadata, PDF albums and slideshows for 100+ image formats, on local files.

interface.longDescription: Convert, resize, watermark and tag whole folders of images (camera RAW, HEIC, AVIF, PSD, PDF and 100+ formats) on your Windows PC. Contenta Converter is a Windows desktop app for batch image conversion, resizing, effects, metadata, PDF albums and slideshows for 100+ image formats; this skill teaches the agent its command-line tool (contenta), so you ask in plain words and the work runs on your own PC, on your own files, with nothing uploaded. It needs Contenta Converter installed (https://www.contenta-converter.com/download.php). In Codex the agent runs the commands for you; in ChatGPT it tells you which command to run. Support: bruno@contenta-software.com
defaultPrompt: Convert every HEIC photo in this folder to JPG at 2000 px wide.
Split this 20-page scanned PDF into one PNG per page.
Resize these product photos to 1000x1000 for my shop and add a watermark.
